learningObjectives: Select and justify field values in a business scenario.
reviewScope: Official topic comparison and original-question editorial review; not vendor endorsement.

elements.description: Field Value rules define allowed values separately from a property. Apply To class and ruleset context allow the same inherited property to have different permitted values. A short, static list shared by all contexts may instead live on the property. Frequently changing external data belongs in a data source rather than hundreds of field-value rules.

elements.text: Worked example: The shared pyStatusWork property needs a custom Resolved-Returned value for Returns cases only. Add the value in the Returns class context; do not clone the standard property for every case type.

elements.title: Training environment checklist
items: Implement the worked example in a training application; use synthetic data.
Test the expected path and at least one failure or boundary condition.
Explain why the alternative mechanism would not meet the requirement.
Revisit incorrect answers in Smart Review rather than memorizing option positions.

elements.text: These notes target the '25 exam. Shared Academy pages may show newer labels with '25 applicability; verify screens in your training environment.

examPitfalls.title: Property versus values
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Each context-specific value requires a new property.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Keep the property reusable and vary Field Value rules by context.

examPitfalls.title: Static rule versus live data
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Use Field Values for a rapidly changing external inventory.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Use an appropriate data source for live records.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Two case types inherit one status property but need different custom statuses. Which design supports that?

options.text: Duplicate the property name with a different type in every class
Put every status in one hard-coded portal label
Field Value rules in the relevant class contexts

practiceQuiz.rationale: Field Values separate allowed values from the property, with class context supporting specialized values.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A list is short, static and identical in all inherited classes. Which simpler option may be sufficient?

options.text: A queue processor for every selection
A new case type per value
A local list on the property
A new connector for every label

practiceQuiz.rationale: A property-local list can fit a short common static enumeration. The context-specific reuse need drives the choice of Field Values.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which Field Value setting controls the class context in which a value is available?
practiceQuiz.rationale: Apply To determines class applicability. The other settings address scheduling, runtime resources and packaging.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A product selector needs thousands of prices updated by a remote catalog. Which source is more appropriate than Field Values?

options.text: A Data Page backed by the catalog
One Field Value for every price change
A new access group for each product

practiceQuiz.rationale: Live data should be retrieved from a data source. Rule-based allowed values are better suited to stable enumerations.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which TWO are advantages of managing allowed values as Field Values?

options.text: Specialize allowed values by class context

practiceQuiz.rationale: Field Values support reuse and contextual specialization. They do not remove validation or authentication.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A custom status should apply only to a specialized case, not all Work- instances. Where should its Field Value be defined?
practiceQuiz.rationale: Use the narrowest appropriate class to avoid making a case-specific value broadly available through inheritance.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A team needs a versioned change to an allowed value. Which mechanism supports Field Value versioning?
practiceQuiz.rationale: Field Values are rules and can be versioned within rulesets; they are not individual work assignments.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A developer adds a new allowed status. Which check is most useful before release?

options.text: Verify the value is offered in the intended class context and not unintentionally elsewhere
Check only that the rule has a name

practiceQuiz.rationale: Context-specific availability must be tested in the consuming case types. Naming alone does not validate applicability.
practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requirement, then compare the scope and timing of each proposed mechanism.
